# Wellog landing page

Published at <https://cccheungcc.github.io/wellog-site/>.

**Do not edit `index.html` here.** It is generated from `site/index.html` in
the private app repo by `site/publish.py`; edits here are overwritten on the
next publish.

To move this to a custom domain, add a CNAME record for the subdomain pointing
at `cccheungcc.github.io`, then set the domain in this repo's Pages settings.
